quests.instruction: Coconut water, a milkshake, and apple cider are all things you do this with. Which word fits?
quests.question: Drink
quests.hint: This word means you swallow it as a liquid, using a cup or a straw.
quests.explanation: Yes! Coconut water, a milkshake, and apple cider are all liquids you swallow using a cup or straw!
quests.funFact: Many of these liquid foods are made by squeezing or blending fruit!

quests.instruction: Broccoli, carrots, and spinach all belong to the same food group. What is it called?
quests.question: Vegetable
quests.hint: This group of foods includes roots, stems, and leaves of plants.
quests.explanation: That's right! Broccoli, carrots, and spinach are all parts of plants that belong to the vegetable group!
quests.funFact: Different foods in this group come from different parts of a plant, like roots or leaves!

quests.instruction: Pomegranates, guavas, and tangerines all belong to the same food group. Which is it?
quests.question: Fruit
quests.hint: This group of foods often needs to be peeled or has a pit inside.
quests.explanation: Great job! Pomegranates, guavas, and tangerines all belong to this food group!
quests.funFact: Explorers used to carry this food group on ships to stay healthy at sea!

quests.instruction: Iced tea, sparkling water, and orange juice are all things you do this with, not chew. What's it called?
quests.question: Drink
quests.hint: This is what you're doing when you use a straw.
quests.explanation: You got it! Iced tea, sparkling water, and orange juice are all things you sip, not chew!
quests.funFact: A straw is one of the handiest tools for enjoying these liquid foods!

quests.instruction: A glass of milk, a slice of cheddar, and a cup of yogurt all belong to the same food group. Which is it?
quests.question: Dairy
quests.hint: This group of foods helps build strong bones and teeth.
quests.explanation: Well done! Milk, cheddar, and yogurt all belong to this bone-strengthening food group!
quests.funFact: A calf could grow huge on the milk that starts this whole food group!

quests.instruction: A slice of pie, a bowl of ice cream, and a warm cookie are all examples of this part of a meal. What is it?
quests.question: Dessert
quests.hint: This part of a meal is almost always the sweetest one.
quests.explanation: Correct! Pie, ice cream, and a warm cookie are all examples of this sweet final course!
quests.funFact: This sweet course can be warm, like pie, or cold, like ice cream!

quests.instruction: Eggs, turkey, and peanuts all belong to the same food group. Which one is it?
quests.question: Protein
quests.hint: This group of foods can come from an animal or a plant.
quests.explanation: Super! Eggs, turkey, and peanuts all belong to this food group, which can come from animals or plants!
quests.funFact: This food group can come from land animals, the sea, or even a plant like a bean!

quests.instruction: Apricots, raspberries, and coconuts all belong to the same food group. Which one is it?
quests.question: Fruit
quests.hint: This group of foods usually holds the seeds of the plant that made it.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Apricots, raspberries, and coconuts all belong to this seed-holding food group!
quests.funFact: This food group comes in more shapes and sizes than almost any other!

quests.instruction: A bagel, a bowl of rice, and a granola bar all belong to the same food group. Which is it?
quests.question: Grain
quests.hint: This group of foods is often ground into flour before it's baked.
quests.explanation: You found it! A bagel, rice, and a granola bar all belong to this food group, often ground into flour first!
quests.funFact: This food group can be white or whole, depending on how much of the seed is used!

quests.instruction: Ham, crab, and black beans all belong to the same food group. Which one is it?
quests.question: Protein
quests.hint: This group of foods can be found at the center of most dinner plates.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Ham, crab, and black beans all belong to this centerpiece food group!
quests.funFact: This food group is why athletes eat a hearty meal before a big game!

quests.instruction: Pasta, cereal, and crackers all belong to the same food group. Which one is it?
quests.question: Grain
quests.hint: This group of foods often gives your body quick energy to run and play.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Pasta, cereal, and crackers are all made from grains, giving your body energy to run and play!
quests.funFact: This food group has been an important part of meals for thousands of years!

quests.instruction: Water, juice, and milk are all things you do this with, not eat. What is that called?
quests.question: Drink
quests.hint: This word describes food you sip, not food you chew.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Water, juice, and milk are all liquids you sip, exactly what this word means!
quests.funFact: Your body needs plenty of these liquid foods every single day to stay healthy!

quests.instruction: Ice cream, whipped cream, and string cheese all belong to the same food group. What is it?
quests.question: Dairy
quests.hint: This group of foods often begins as milk from an animal.
quests.explanation: Yes! Ice cream, whipped cream, and string cheese all begin as milk, part of the dairy group!
quests.funFact: This food group is used to make hundreds of treats, from ice cream to cheesecake!

quests.instruction: Quinoa, a slice of rye bread, and puffed rice cereal all belong to the same food group. What's it called?
quests.question: Grain
quests.hint: This group of foods is harvested from fields in the late summer or fall.
quests.explanation: That's right! Quinoa, rye bread, and puffed rice cereal all belong to this harvested food group!
quests.funFact: Some countries celebrate a big harvest festival just for this important food group!

quests.instruction: Lettuce, asparagus, and eggplant all belong to the same food group. What's it called?
quests.question: Vegetable
quests.hint: This group of foods is usually part of a healthy, colorful side dish.
quests.explanation: Great job! Lettuce, asparagus, and eggplant all belong to this colorful, savory food group!
quests.funFact: Eating lots of colors from this food group helps give your body different vitamins!

quests.instruction: Lamb, trout, and pinto beans all belong to the same food group. What is it?
quests.question: Protein
quests.hint: This group of foods gives your growing body its essential building blocks.
quests.explanation: You got it! Lamb, trout, and pinto beans all belong to this essential food group!
quests.funFact: Your body needs a bit of this food group at nearly every meal to grow strong!

quests.instruction: Corn tortillas, oat cereal, and brown rice all belong to the same food group. What is it?
quests.question: Grain
quests.hint: This group of foods forms the base of many meals around the world.
quests.explanation: Well done! Corn tortillas, oat cereal, and brown rice all belong to this base food group!
quests.funFact: One single stalk of wheat can hold dozens of tiny seeds from this food group!

quests.instruction: Ricotta, a milkshake, and a slice of swiss cheese all belong to the same food group. What is it?
quests.question: Dairy
quests.hint: This group of foods is famous for starting out as a liquid, not a solid.
quests.explanation: Correct! Ricotta, a milkshake, and swiss cheese all start as a liquid, part of the dairy group!
quests.funFact: It can take about ten glasses of milk to make just one glass-sized block of cheese!

quests.instruction: Hot tea, chocolate milk, and grape juice are all things you do this with, not eat. What is it?
quests.question: Drink
quests.hint: This is the word for a liquid you have with a cup, not a fork.
quests.explanation: Super! Hot tea, chocolate milk, and grape juice are all liquids you have with a cup, not a fork!
quests.funFact: Staying hydrated with plenty of these each day helps your whole body work well!

quests.instruction: Salmon, tofu, and almonds all belong to the same food group. Which is it?
quests.question: Protein
quests.hint: This group of foods is important for growing strong, healthy muscles.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Salmon, tofu, and almonds all belong to this muscle-strengthening food group!
quests.funFact: Even some plants, like beans and nuts, belong to this important food group!

quests.instruction: Zucchini, radishes, and cauliflower all belong to the same food group. Which one is it?
quests.question: Vegetable
quests.hint: This group of foods is savory, not the sweet kind you'd want for dessert.
quests.explanation: You found it! Zucchini, radishes, and cauliflower all belong to this savory food group!
quests.funFact: This food group grows in nearly every part of the world, in every season!

quests.instruction: Pie, pudding, and brownies are usually saved for this part of a meal. Which one is it?
quests.question: Dessert
quests.hint: This is the sweet treat you might get after finishing your vegetables.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Pie, pudding, and brownies are all sweet treats that belong to this final course!
quests.funFact: In many homes, this sweet course is the part of dinner kids look forward to most!

quests.instruction: Pork, tuna, and chickpeas all belong to the same food group. What is it?
quests.question: Protein
quests.hint: This group of foods often takes the biggest spot on your dinner plate.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Pork, tuna, and chickpeas all belong to this important food group, often the main part of a meal!
quests.funFact: This food group is one of the most important ones for a growing body!

quests.instruction: Cucumbers, tomatoes, and mushrooms are often grouped together at dinner. What's it called?
quests.question: Vegetable
quests.hint: This group is often the colorful side dish next to the main course.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Cucumbers, tomatoes, and mushrooms are all commonly grouped with this savory food group!
quests.funFact: This food group comes in almost every color, from green to purple to orange!

quests.instruction: Parmesan, plain yogurt, and a milkshake all belong to the same food group. Which one is it?
quests.question: Dairy
quests.hint: This group of foods is famous for helping kids grow taller and stronger.
quests.explanation: Yes! Parmesan, plain yogurt, and a milkshake all belong to this bone-building food group!
quests.funFact: Cheese was likely discovered by accident, from milk carried in a bag long ago!

quests.instruction: Blueberries, cherries, and kiwis all belong to the same food group. Which group is it?
quests.question: Fruit
quests.hint: This group of foods is usually the sweetest one on your plate.
quests.explanation: That's right! Blueberries, cherries, and kiwis all belong to this sweet, seed-bearing food group!
quests.funFact: Doctors say eating from this colorful food group every day is great for your health!

quests.instruction: Duck, sardines, and edamame all belong to the same food group. What's it called?
quests.question: Protein
quests.hint: This group of foods helps your body repair itself after playing hard.
quests.explanation: Great job! Duck, sardines, and edamame all belong to this repair-and-rebuild food group!
quests.funFact: Your body uses this food group to repair itself after a busy day of playing!

quests.instruction: A flour tortilla, couscous, and a bowl of grits all belong to the same food group. Which is it?
quests.question: Grain
quests.hint: This group of foods is often milled or ground before it's cooked.
quests.explanation: You got it! A flour tortilla, couscous, and grits all belong to this milled food group!
quests.funFact: This food group can be planted, grown, and harvested all in about one season!

quests.instruction: Fruit punch, plain seltzer, and warm cider are all things you do this with, not eat. What is it?
quests.question: Drink
quests.hint: This word means something poured, not something served on a plate.
quests.explanation: Well done! Fruit punch, seltzer, and warm cider are all things poured into a cup, not served on a plate!
quests.funFact: People all around the world have their own favorite version of this liquid food!

quests.instruction: A cheese stick, a glass of milk, and a tub of yogurt all belong to the same food group. Which is it?
quests.question: Dairy
quests.hint: This group of foods is often recommended a few times a day for growing kids.
quests.explanation: Correct! A cheese stick, milk, and yogurt all belong to this food group recommended for growing kids!
quests.funFact: This food group provides protein as well as calcium for your growing body!
